title: Fraud Model Retraining Experiment and Temporal Holdout Evaluation
model_selection_policy: Threshold selection uses validation data only. Do not use held-out test metrics repeatedly for tuning or promotion decisions.
important_caveat: Repeated timestamps occur at split boundaries. Timestamp-group separation must be verified before claiming fully independent temporal validation. Final-test results do not establish future or production performance.
publication_note: Aggregate research outputs only. Record-level test predictions and transaction-level explainability artifacts are excluded from the public release.
